instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after command, report, screenshot, trace, or log evidence exists.

features.description: Release baseline identifies current code shape, validation evidence, runtime blockers, and safe edit boundaries.
steps: Inspect repository scripts, route files, compose files, assistant API files, and current diff.
Execute backend, frontend, compose, lint, and target microservice validation commands.
Write baseline report and update source packet plus continuity ledger.
features.evidence: docs/general_ai_assistant_upgrade/reports/gaa-00-baseline-release-audit-report.md records pytest, frontend build/type/lint, compose config, microservice isolation, and missing .env blocker evidence.
features.notes: Full page walkthrough and live service failure isolation require .env plus a running compose stack.

features.description: Assistant core contracts support upgraded assistant behavior while preserving gateway, session, artifact, service isolation, and tenant boundaries.
steps: Read assistant API, assistant-service runtime, shared core proxy/storage/session modules, and assistant tests listed in GAA-01.
Implement one bounded assistant-core contract slice.
Record pytest evidence and contract impact in the phase report.
features.evidence: docs/general_ai_assistant_upgrade/reports/gaa-01-assistant-core-contracts-report.md records artifact schema-missing read contract changes plus pytest and scoped ruff evidence.
features.notes: Full assistant-service ruff command still has pre-existing lint blockers; touched-file ruff passes.

features.description: Assistant user experience works across protected routes, runtime config, SSE, telemetry, and page states with browser evidence.
steps: Read assistant page, chat helpers, auth store, router, runtime config, and site walkthrough E2E.
Implement one bounded assistant UI slice.
Record type-check, build, lint, and browser walkthrough evidence.
features.evidence: docs/general_ai_assistant_upgrade/reports/gaa-02-assistant-user-experience-report.md records frontend type-check/build/lint evidence, assistant route E2E passing 2/2, site walkthrough passing 1/1, and targeted backend regression checks for runtime 500 fixes.
features.notes: GAA-03 is unlocked. Browser checks used the running local stack at frontend 127.0.0.1:8081 and backend 127.0.0.1:8080 with E2E_REUSE_SERVER=1.

features.description: Assistant upgrade has golden behavior, tool-boundary, privacy, refusal, and cost/quota evidence before release.
steps: Read assistant golden tests, guardrail tests, tool orchestration tests, safe fetch tests, and eval fixtures.
Add or update bounded eval coverage for the selected assistant capability.
Record deterministic eval evidence and residual AI behavior risks.
features.evidence: docs/general_ai_assistant_upgrade/reports/gaa-03-ai-evaluation-and-safety-report.md records new deterministic eval/safety contract tests passing 6/6 plus required GAA-03 pytest groups passing 5/5, 110/110, and 96/96 with touched-file ruff passing.
features.notes: GAA-04 is unlocked. Coverage pins runtime memory prompt-injection neutralization, PII redaction, tool-result cap metadata, bounded KB summaries, and privacy/refusal/system-prompt guardrails without live provider calls.

features.description: Deployment readiness proves config, health, smoke, rollback, and monitoring gates for the assistant upgrade.
steps: Read README, DEPLOY, Makefile, compose files, validation scripts, and prior phase reports.
Run config and runtime checks with a real .env and compose stack.
Record release evidence, skipped gates, rollback commands, and launch decision.

The supplied external env is readable but still needs valid REDIS_PASSWORD, DOCGEN_ARTIFACT_SIGN_KEY, DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD, AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN, KNOWLEDGE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS_JSON, and ASSISTANT_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS_JSON before full release validation can pass. Current-user edit is covered by the browser smoke; mocked dynamic-route render smoke covers knowledge/exam detail, public share, and public quiz page renderability without database writes; the live walkthrough can cover those routes when records exist, but the current stack has zero seed records for those route families. Non-destructive live-stack breaker isolation and compose-backed stop/start failure-isolation both pass locally; only the langgraph-agent stop/start case skips because that service is absent from the local compose stack.
